content.title: A Dive Into Timothée Chalamet's Dating History, From Kylie Jenner Engagement Rumors to Romancing Madonna's Daughter
content.text: Timothée Chalamet has been romantically linked to Lourdes Leon, Lily-Rose Depp, Eiza González, and Sarah Talabi.The actor has been dating Kylie Jenner since 2023. Chalamet gave her a heartfelt tribute at the 2026 Critics Choice Awards. While there are many top contenders for the internet's best boyfriend—Pedro Pascal, Jeremy Allen White, Glen Powell, Michael B. Jordan, Charles Melton to name a few—there's something about Timothée Chalamet that consistently keeps him in the top spot. Maybe it's his floppy tousled hair and chiseled jaw line, or maybe it's his award-winning acting chops, charming awkwardness, and bilingual abilities. Either way, he's been a certified social media heartthrob since his 2017 breakthrough roles in Call Me By Your Name and Ladybird. Almost a decade later, Chalamet has evolved into a full-blown leading man with pictures like Dune, A Complete Unknown, and Marty Supreme inching him closer into "greatness" territory (as he famously said he's striving for during his 2025 SAG Awards acceptance speech). Kylie Jenner and Timothee Chalamet at the 83rd Golden Globes on January 11, 2026. Getty Images But that's not the only memorable speech Chalamet has given. In January 2026, the actor made fans swoon by shouting out his girlfriend, Kylie Jenner, at the 2026 Critics Choice Awards. "Thank you to my partner of three years. Thank you for our foundation. I love you, I couldn't do this without you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart," he said, sealing the deal with a kiss. He once again thanked his "partner" at the 2026 Golden Globes, making a convincing argument for the two being endgame. (Sorry, internet, but he's off the market.) Whether you're a superfan who's been around since Chalamet's 2009 appearance on Law & Order and high school hit song "Statistics (Ms. Lawton)" or you just got swept into his orbit this awards season, there's so much to love about the 30-year-old. Ahead, find a deep dive into the handsome young actor's love life, from his teenage romance with Madonna's daughter and his high-profile coupling with Lily-Rose Depp to his long-term relationship with Jenner. Lourdes Leon (2013) Getty Images During his time at New York City's famed Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School, the actor dated fellow student Lourdes Leon, who happens to be Madonna's daughter. While the pair have remained rather tight-lipped about their short-lived flame, it appears they have stayed in touch over the years. During a 2017 interview on SiriusXM's Radio Andy, Chalamet shared that he'd chatted with Leon about his Call Me By Your Name role. "She hasn't seen it yet, but she's excited to," Chalamet told Andy Cohen. "She teases me about the public appearances … the movie itself she's very excited about and the reception it's been getting is only a great thing. It's like the public appearance stuff around it, like some of the late-night things I've done. I get made fun of." When Cohen asked how long they dated, he blushed and replied, "Next question," with a laugh. Meanwhile, Leon sweetly reminisced about their time together during an April 2021 interview with Vanity Fair: "I respect him a lot. We were a little item," she said. "My first boyfriend." Lily-Rose Depp (September 2018-April 2020) Lily-Rose Depp and Timothee Chalamet attend 'The King' red carpet during the 76th Venice Film Festival on September 2, 2019, in Venice, Italy. Getty Images In what was his first high-profile relationship, Chalamet was linked to Lily-Rose Depp, daughter of Johnny Depp and Vanessa Paradis. Their romance is believed to have started in September 2018 after they were spotted getting cozy and locking lips in New York City on several occasions. It was clear things were heating up between them when they enjoyed a trip to Paris that December. The two met while working on Netflix's The King. They made a stunning public appearance at the film's premiere at the 2019 Venice Film Festival, and followed that up with a steamy makeout session on a boat in Capri, Italy. Chalamet opened up about the moment during a November 2020 interview with GQ. "I went to bed that night thinking that was one of the best days of my life. I was on this boat all day with someone I really loved, and closing my eyes, I was like, indisputably, 'That was great.' And then waking up to all these pictures, and feeling embarrassed, and looking like a real knob? All pale?" he shared. "And then people are like, 'This is a PR stunt.' A PR stunt?! Do you think I'd want to look like that in front of all of you?!" By April 2020, it was reported that Chalamet and Depp had split. Neither party has publicly addressed the breakup. Eiza González (2020) Getty Images The Dune actor moved on from Depp to a summer fling with Eiza González. In June 2020, the two were seen enjoying a getaway in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico. A source told People at the time that the pair traveled in a private jet with friends for a five-day stay at Chileno Bar. "They enjoyed the luxury resort and seemed to have the best time. They recently started hanging out and they looked happy together," the insider said. "They hung out in the sun, [ate] amazing food and relaxed. It was a fun getaway." Another source told the publication that González had recently split with Australian actor Luke Bracey and was "talking on and off" with Chalamet. However, the pair had called it quits by October 2020. Sarah Talabi (2022) Getty Images Chalamet caused a bit of a stir at Coachella in April 2022 when he was spotted with Sarah Talabi. The model and influencer posted an Instagram story from the festival, adding, "Had the best time with the best group of people." She tagged the actor, her twin sister Leah Talabi, and a friend. She confirmed to Page Six that she did in fact spend time with the actor, but quickly changed the subject when asked for details. "I was at Coachella this weekend, as well as the Revolve Festival, and a few other private parties. That was me in the photos; my twin sister, Leah Talabi, was there, too. We were all just hanging out and vibing with the music. It was the greatest night of my life," she said. "Everyone is asking me if I was kissing Timothée Chalamet at Coachella, and that is a good question. But a great question would be asking our world leaders why the Earth is now losing 1.2 trillion tons of ice each year due to global warming and why climate crisis reform has been completely ineffective." Kylie Jenner (April 2023-Present) Timothee Chalamet and Kylie Jenner attend the Los Angeles premiere of 'Marty Supreme' on December 8, 2025. Getty Images In what just might be one of the most internet-breaking relationships of the 2020s, Chalamet was first spotted with Kylie Jenner in her Range Rover in April 2023. A source told People at the time that they were "hanging out and getting to know each other." These romance rumors came just a couple of months after it was reported that Jenner and Travis Scott, the father of her two children, had split. During the first few months of Jenner and Chalamet's romance, sources close to the beauty mogul maintained that things were "not serious," adding that “Kylie enjoys dating, but her main focus is being a mom.” However, the two seemed to seal the deal on their relationship with a PDA-packed date at the U.S. Open in September of that year. Jenner quickly changed her tune as their relationship progressed, even stepping out to support Chalamet at the Golden Globes in 2024. By then, a source told People that the couple was "super serious and very involved with each other's day to day lives." Timothee Chalamet and Kylie Jenner make their red carpet debut at the 70th David Di Donatello on May 7, 2025, in Rome, Italy. Getty Images Jenner was the most supportive girlfriend during the 2025 awards circuit, when Chalamet was up for his role in A Complete Unknown. Although she forewent the carpet to let her man shine, she accompanied him inside the Golden Globes, BAFTAs, and Oscars ceremonies. After almost two years of dating, Kimothee finally made their red carpet debut at the 70th David Di Donatello Awards on May 7, 2025, in coordinating black ensembles. They ended the year by showing just what a power couple they are in matching tangerine-orange Chrome Hearts ensembles at the Marty Supreme Los Angeles premiere. Heading into 2026 and their third year of dating, Chalamet loved his boo loud and proud at the Critics Choice Awards and Golden Globes. During his remarks for Best Actor, he gave thanks and love to his "partner," which caused a flurry of engagement speculation.
